stages.name: fallback
stages.purpose: take over if primary did not complete; otherwise verify only

stages.name: final_check
stages.purpose: repair any remaining missing review/data/deploy/audit/TOC stages and verify production

guarantees: Do not silently treat an incomplete review as zero accepted papers.
If the primary run misses or exits early, later stages must attempt the full update while tools remain available.
A run is complete only after review persistence, accepted-data write, production verification, TOC queue refresh, and coordination-state update.
If external services are unavailable, persist the blocking evidence so the next stage/run can resume.
automationResilience.note: This materially reduces single-point scheduling and execution failures, but external platform/network outages cannot be made mathematically impossible.
